audience: freelancers and small teams that track time against projects in solidtime

useCases.title: Start or stop a timer
useCases.text: Check the running timer, start a timer for a member, or stop the timer that runs now.

useCases.title: Log a finished time entry
useCases.text: Log a time entry with a start and an end for a member. Read the organizations first to get the member id.

useCases.title: Review tracked time by project
useCases.text: List the time entries of a time window, then read the projects and clients they belong to.

useCases.title: Find open tasks in a project
useCases.text: List the tasks of a project. Done tasks stay hidden unless you ask for them.
